event_contract.cluster_dedupe_rule: Cluster by symbol when consecutive event timestamps are no more than 14400 seconds apart.
event_contract.entry_time: First complete interval open strictly after the event timestamp.
event_contract.event_definition: Synthetic imbalance is greater than the frozen fixture threshold at a complete interval.
event_contract.event_independence_rule: Only the first event in each four-hour cluster is retained.
event_contract.invalidation: Reject missing, non-monotonic, or same-snapshot entry and outcome timestamps.

material_difference_from_prior_work: Contract-only synthetic fixture with no market observations.

source_contract.missingness_policy: Reject any event missing either required channel.

statistical_plan.bootstrap_or_resampling_plan: Moving-block and stationary bootstrap with seed 2202 and 1000 synthetic repetitions.
statistical_plan.power_or_sequential_evidence_plan: Freeze a sequential confidence interval and return insufficient when width exceeds the stated tolerance.
